memory_update.note: Keep GE Aerospace in the reference lane only. ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The specific supplier-review claim is currently labeled speculation. No primary source in the provided evidence confirms that GE Aerospace is creating a material, incremental chokepoint for domestic-content aerospace components or defense supplier compliance.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Ranked only because it is the sole candidate in the chunk. GE Aerospace can serve as a reference anchor for testing whether defense-aerospace primes and engine suppliers are tightening domestic-content, raw-material-origin, cyber, quality, and supplier-compliance requirements. Any Serenity value would come from using GE as a demand-pressure map to identify lower-tier suppliers, inspection vendors, specialty materials companies, compliance software providers, or certified manufacturing networks with more obscure exposure.

summary: The chunk contains only GE Aerospace, a mega-cap reference leader rather than an underfollowed Serenity candidate. It is useful for mapping downstream aerospace and defense supplier-pressure vectors, but it should rank low as an alpha-discovery candidate because the claimed hidden signal is speculative, not yet supported by primary evidence, and GE's public-market exposure is broad rather than pure to domestic-content or supplier-compliance chokepoints.
